Select which is the true expression. Sarah has 5 hundreds plus 6 tens plus 2 ones. Mike has 500 + 60 + 2 ~~Sarah>Mike | Sarah<Mike | Sarah=Mike~~
Solution: Sarah has 500 + 60 + 2 = 562, and Mike also has 500 + 60 + 2 = 562. Their amounts are equal. Choose Sarah=Mike.

Question Choices: Select who has more eggs. A farmer has 6 hundreds 15 tens 4 ones eggs. A grocery store has 754 eggs. ~~farmer | grocery-store | same amount~~
Solution: The farmer has 600 + 150 + 4 = 754 eggs. The grocery store also has 754. Neither has more; they have the same amount.

Question Choices: Select all boxes with the most beads. Red has 7 hundreds 2 tens, blue has 720, green has 600 + 100, and yellow has 6 hundreds 9 tens. ~~red | blue | green | yellow~~
Solution: Red has 700 + 20 = 720 beads; blue has 720; green has 600 + 100 = 700; yellow has 600 + 90 = 690. Red and blue tie for the largest count. Select both.
